title: Squidra API error envelope v1
description: Normative error shape for all /api/v1 routes (T00, ADR-007). code is a stable machine string for control flow; message is public human text and MUST NOT contain secrets or PII; requestId correlates with traces (SRS P-07); details is route-schema-bound and filtered.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. POLICY_DENIED, CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, TIMED_OUT.

message.description: Public human-readable message. No secrets, credentials, connection strings, or PII.

requestId.description: UUID correlating this response with server traces (SRS P-07 runId/traceId).

schemaVersion.description: Envelope version. Breaking changes ship a new version per ADR-007 rule 3.

details.description: Optional filtered detail object bound by the route's schema. MUST NOT contain secrets.
